name: Knees Up Seated Together White Background
name_es: Knees Up Seated Together White Background
pose_description:
bodyPosition: Seated on the floor on a seamless white background. Buttocks on the ground, torso facing the camera with a slight forward lean of the upper body.
legs: bothLegs: Knees bent and pulled upward toward the torso, kept together (knees touching or nearly touching). Thighs close to each other. Feet planted on the floor. leftLeg: Knee raised and held close to the other knee. rightLeg: Knee raised and held close to the other knee.
feet: Planted on the floor. Toes pointing slightly outward.
torso: Upright with a subtle forward lean. Shoulders squared and relaxed, facing the camera.
arms: bothArms: Extended downward along the sides of the body. Hands placed on the floor beside or slightly behind the hips for support.
hands: Relaxed, fingers lightly curled, palms down on the floor providing balance.
head: Facing the camera directly, chin level to slightly lowered.
